title: Visual world: Investigate (hand 2 of the roll)
question: The re-roll assigned The Synoptic Chart Room. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: The Synoptic Chart Room
options.lineage: mid-century weather analysis rooms: station-model plots, drawn isobars, warm/cold front symbols
options.thesis: Threatbase is an observation network, and an IOC is a storm system being analysed: every feed and honeypot a reporting station that plots what it saw, and the analyst draws the isobars through the evidence.
options.viewport: The IOC sits mid-page as a low-pressure center on the chart field; the sources that flagged it cluster around it as station plots with their readings, drawn isobars of risk contour through them, and a bulletin card at the margin states the verdict like a storm warning.
options.risk: Nostalgia drift into decorative map-shop, and a weather bulletin idiom may read soft to enterprise buyers.

raised.raise: Failed and skipped sources plot in dim red at their station position; the chart grid never breaks for a missing observation.
One safety-orange commit control (Block / Export) on the whole page; every other action stays ink.
Full keyboard operation with numbered exits on every panel.
Asymmetry as compositional law: the chart field is placed off-axis at analysis scale, never a centered hero.

options.label: The Customs Hall
options.lineage: passport control: examination windows, ink entry/exit stamps, watchlist cards, document lamps
options.thesis: A blocklist decision is border control: the IOC presents its papers, each source is an officer's check, and the page ends in the physical act of stamping admit or deny.
materials: passport-paper ground with guilloche safety pattern
options.viewport: The IOC arrives as an open passport spread: its identity page left, the source-check stamps landing right one by one, verdict a giant angled DENIED/ADMIS stamp bleeding through the paper.
options.risk: The most obvious idiom for a blocklist, exactly where most runs land; stamp metaphors tempt decorative ink smudges.

options.label: Tensegrity Load Frame
options.lineage: Snelson-style tension-compression sculpture with engineering annotations
options.thesis: The dossier as a load-bearing structure: evidence members in tension and compression, annotations pinned to nodes on leader lines.
options.case: Holds product clarity (relations literally carry load; slack/stressed/failed states map to corroboration strength) but loses audience identification for analysts.
options.risk: Layout obeying a strut network fights dense evidence text.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.lineage: segmented travel documents beside a live gate board
options.thesis: The dossier is the pass: labeled segments, tabular figures, a scannable block; live feed status is the gate board reranking in place.
materials: alert color held on changed rows
options.case: Strong clarity for the dossier-as-document structure, weak identification: an investigator is not a departing passenger.
options.risk: Two visual systems (pass + board) competing on one surface.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.case: A single IOC dossier is not a ranked board of live entities; rows-by-time has no true mapping here.
options.kept: Changed/failed states restyle without breaking the grid (now a raise).

options.label: ANSI Nightboard BBS
options.case: Cyan-on-black terminal black returns you to the cockpit world this brief replaces, and the cell grid cannot carry a graph or calendar.
options.kept: Numbered keyboard exits everywhere (now a raise).

options.label: Creator Hardware Bench
options.case: Analysts do not live at a keycap bench; the knob-and-key world is charm without identification.
options.kept: One safety-orange commit control (now a raise).

options.label: Raku Smoke Flash
options.lineage: raku kiln lifting and reduction firing
options.case: Thermal states have no truthful mapping to source verdicts; forcing one would make the visual claim a costume.
options.kept: Asymmetry as compositional law (now a raise).

options.label: The category standard
options.lineage: modern intel consoles (VirusTotal, Recorded Future idiom)
options.thesis: Clean score ring, tabbed evidence panels, sortable tables, blue-grey calm.
options.viewport: Search centered, verdict ring left, evidence tabs right, exactly as analysts expect.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
